signin.title: Welcome back
signin.description: Sign in with your account details to access your dashboard.
signin.ambiguousTenant: Your email belongs to more than one organization. Choose which one to use:
signin.submitError: We couldn't complete the sign-in. Try again in a few seconds.
signin.wpLoginRequired: We didn't detect an active session on your home platform. Sign in here with your email and password.

forgot.title: Recover your password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.submitError: We couldn't process your request. Try again.
forgot.successHint: If it doesn't arrive within a few minutes, check your spam folder or request a new link.
forgot.tenantIntro: You are recovering the password for

reset.title: Set your new password
reset.description: Choose a strong password: at least 12 characters, mixing uppercase, lowercase, numbers and symbols.
reset.missingTokenBody: This link is not valid. Request a new one from the recovery screen.
reset.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 12 characters long.
reset.submitError: We couldn't update your password. Try again or request a new link.
reset.doneBody: Your password was updated. Redirecting you to sign in…

mfaSetup.title: Set up your second factor
mfaSetup.description: Your role requires two-step authentication. Scan the QR with your TOTP app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy) and confirm the code.

mfaVerify.title: Second factor
mfaVerify.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your TOTP app, or a recovery code if you lost access.

oidcCallback.missingData: Data is missing from the callback. Try signing in again.
oidcCallback.progressBody: We received your authorization from the IdP, you're almost in.

oidcErrorTitle.idp_error: The identity provider rejected the authorization
oidcErrorTitle.user_not_provisioned: You don't have an account in this tenant
oidcErrorTitle.tenant_not_configured: SSO is not available for this organization

oidcErrorDescription.state_invalid: The security token of your session wasn't recognized. This usually happens if you opened the flow in another tab or waited more than 10 minutes. Try signing in again.
oidcErrorDescription.state_expired: More than 10 minutes passed between the redirect to the IdP and the response. Try signing in again.
oidcErrorDescription.idp_error: Your corporate IdP did not authorize the login. Contact your organization's admin if this persists.
oidcErrorDescription.iss_mismatch: The id_token came with an issuer different from the configured one. Ask the admin to review the SSO configuration.
oidcErrorDescription.aud_mismatch: The id_token has an audience different from our client_id. Ask the admin to review the SSO configuration.
oidcErrorDescription.nonce_mismatch: The id_token nonce doesn't match the flow's nonce. We cancelled the login for security reasons. Try again.
oidcErrorDescription.email_not_allowed: Your IdP email doesn't belong to the domains allowed for SSO in this tenant. Contact the admin to have it added.
oidcErrorDescription.user_not_provisioned: SSO authenticated you, but the admin hasn't enabled automatic account creation. Ask the admin to create your account.
oidcErrorDescription.user_inactive: Contact the tenant admin to reactivate it.
oidcErrorDescription.tenant_not_configured: Ask the admin to configure SSO, or sign in with email + password.
oidcErrorDescription.idp_unreachable: We couldn't reach the identity provider. Try again in a few minutes. If it persists, notify the admin.
oidcErrorDescription.config_changed: Try signing in again. If it persists, contact the admin.
oidcErrorDescription.bad_request: Data is missing from the callback URL. This usually means /auth/callback was accessed outside the OIDC flow.
oidcErrorDescription.missing_tokens: We didn't receive the tokens in the callback. Try signing in again.
oidcErrorDescription.me_failed: Your authentication succeeded, but the API rejected the GET /me. Try again.
oidcErrorDescription.internal: Something went wrong during the SSO sign-in. Try again; if it persists, contact the tenant admin.

onboarding.photoDescription: Upload an image so the community can recognize you. It is required.

setup.metaDescription: First-boot wizard to create your organization and your administrator account.
setup.tagline: Open, modular education platform — initial setup
setup.footer: This screen only appears the first time. After creating your admin account you can invite the rest of your team from Settings → Users.
setup.strengthGoodHint: Making it longer makes it better.
setup.initError: We couldn't complete the setup. Try again in a few seconds.
setup.initConflict: This platform was already initialized. Go back to the sign-in screen and enter with your admin account.
setup.initTokenInvalid: The setup token is not valid or was already used. Check the container logs from the first boot (docker logs) and open the most recent link.
setup.initTokenMissing: The setup token is missing from the URL. Open it with the link that appears in the container logs after the first boot (docker logs), with the format /setup?token=...
setup.welcomeBody: You have just installed your own copy of the platform. In less than a minute you will have your organization configured and you will be able to start creating courses, inviting trainers and managing students.
setup.bulletYoursBody: Self-hosted, open source. Your data lives in your infrastructure.
setup.bulletModularBody: Enable only the modules you need: courses, community, FUNDAE, certificates, AI…
setup.bulletMultiTenantBody: One instance, multiple isolated organizations with Postgres RLS.
setup.bulletOpenCoreBody: The community edition is free. Enterprise features are unlocked with a license.
setup.orgDescription: Basic details of the main tenant. You can add more organizations later from the super_admin panel.
setup.hostnameHint: Detected automatically. Change it if you are going to access through another domain or if you set up a CDN in front.
setup.slugHint: Internal identifier (DNS-safe). The API uses it and it is visible if you have to sign in without going through your domain. By default it is generated from the name.
setup.modulesTitle: Enable the modules you are going to use
setup.modulesDescription: This defines which areas of the platform are available for your organization at start. The ones checked here stay enabled by default in your tenant; any of them can be enabled or disabled later from Settings → Modules.
setup.modulesLoadError: We couldn't load the list of modules. Try again.
setup.adminDescription: This account has full access to the platform. Store the password in a password manager: for security reasons we cannot recover it by email yet if you are the only admin.
setup.tourTitle: Done! Here is what comes next
setup.tourDescription: Your instance is now active. Here are the three places where you will spend the most time at first:
setup.tourCoursesBody: Create your first course, organize modules and enroll students. It is where the content lives.
setup.tourCommunityBody: Forums and a feed per course. Useful when you want students to collaborate and solve doubts among themselves.
setup.tourAdminBody: Users, roles, branding, active modules, integrations. Everything about the organization lives under /admin.
setup.tourNextStepBody: Enable MFA for your admin account from your profile <mono>(My profile → Security)</mono> as soon as you get in. It is the only thing between you and the rest of the world.
